units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 42">Ex. R. s. 42</cite> <he>מדינה ששלחה פ׳ לעטר וכ׳</he> (not <he>טים …</he>) a province that sent a legate to offer a crown to the king. Tanḥ. Vayigg. 6 <he>שלח יהורה פרוזבטים אצלו</he> (corr. acc.) he (Jacob) sent Judah as an ambassador to him (Joseph).

Yalk. Esth. 1058 שונאי הוא שירדתי עמו בפ׳ he (Mordecai) is my enemy, since I came down with him (from Palestine) as a legate (to plead against the building of the Temple, v. preced.).—Pl. פְּרוּזְבּוּטִין. Y’lamd. to Deut. I, 1, quot. in Ar. פרזבטין, v. פְּרוֹזְבִּיטְרוֹן.—Greek pl. פְּרוּזְבּוּטֵי q. v.
